capacity_gross_kwh.notes: 28 kWh nominal lithium-ion pack (Johnson Controls-Saft); bare capacity read as gross.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Ford preliminary 2011 specification: battery voltage range 215-390 V (system 260-380 V), motor 300 V nominal; the sub-500 V class is recorded as 400v.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: 2012 van with a 3.3 kW J1772 charger and no DC port; no page describes any battery preconditioning feature. Not confirmed by an owner's manual. No maker launch of battery preconditioning could be cited; moot for a car with no DC port (dc_max_kw 0), so owner decision requested.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia names only the SAE J1772 connector and a 3.3 kW onboard charger; no DC fast charging is mentioned anywhere (repo model note also says none).

ac_max_kw.notes: "The onboard charger has a maximum rate of 3.3 kW" (100-240 V AC).
